svg.aria-label: contextify. Stale agent line? Zero tokens. Chips: Time saved, Context kept, Tokens saved. An AGENTS.md card with line 6, make test-health, marked stale and linked to a Makefile card where the test-health target is crossed out; the drift check costs 0 tokens. Install: npx skills add Aboudjem/contextify -g. Works with agent skills; tested in Claude Code and Codex.
